_comment: Copy to config.json and point it at your Binance MCP server. Tool names are remappable to whatever your MCP server exposes — no code changes needed. Use a dedicated Agent OS subaccount with a small balance.

mcp._auth: official server uses OAuth: authenticate once via Claude Code (/mcp), then run Jaga with MCP_BEARER_TOKEN=<access_token>. Run `node jaga.mjs --config config.json --list-tools` to see real tool names, then fill tools.* below.

dashboard._remote: to expose beyond localhost (Docker, a VPS): "host": "0.0.0.0" plus "token": "<16+ chars>" (or env JAGA_DASHBOARD_TOKEN); open /?token=… once in the browser, send Authorization: Bearer for curl/MCP

alerts.ntfy: https://ntfy.sh/<your-secret-topic> (optional: free push to your phone via the ntfy app)

llm._comment: OpenAI-compatible. Key via env: LLM_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_API_KEY / VENICE_API_KEY
